name: War-Awoken Dragon Ride (Weapon Skill)
effects:
Single-target Wind/NE piercing jump attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/4 Dragoon/IX members

WS Gold: Instant Physical to all allies
